'''Europa Point F.C.''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club from [[Gibraltar]]. The club currently plays in the [[Gibraltar Football League]], the top tier of [[football in Gibraltar]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sportskeeda.com/football/i-trained-with-the-argentinian-national-team-with-the-likes-of-messi-aguero-di-maria-says-indian-born-uday-arora|title="I trained with the Argentinian National team, with the likes of Messi, Aguero, Di Maria" says Indian born Uday Arora|website=sportskeeda.com|publisher=Sportskeeda|first=Soumalya|last=Moitra|date=4 November 2016|access-date=30 March 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220330072616/https://www.sportskeeda.com/football/i-trained-with-the-argentinian-national-team-with-the-likes-of-messi-aguero-di-maria-says-indian-born-uday-arora|archive-date=30 March 2022}}</ref> They also participate in the [[Rock Cup]], the territory's primary cup competition."}}
